## berth env accept

store the secrets typed inside the org with berth-secret-drop

### Synopsis

store the secrets typed inside the org with berth-secret-drop

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_env_accept/

```

```

### Examples
